## Bug Fixes
- **Version shows again, Power Five lists again.** A stale `stage.priority` reference threw inside the
  relics panel, which aborted the rest of the render: the header stayed at `v—` and the Power Five body
  was never filled, so toggling it looked like nothing happened.
- `render` now catches its own errors and prints them in the warnings strip, so one broken panel can no
  longer blank the rest of the window.
